parameter_schema.notes: fixed filter radius and full recession basis; only recession_strength moves. The radius scan is a separate variant and never claims the same-basis nesting. radius_mm=2.0 is the resolution-qualified choice: smaller radii produce a recession below the frozen grid spacing and are refused with PRECISION_NOT_REALIZED (measured spacing is reported).

edge-distance driven inward fillet built from the analytic rolling-ball section of every convex edge on the ROI boundary and subtracted from the source; never a whole-patch Laplacian and never a global level set. edge_width_mm is the fillet radius and stays frozen across the five levels -- only recession_strength moves, as a linear scale of that section. The planar chamfer variant generates new edges and is not reported as a smooth fillet. The section is exact, so the declared recession is realized at every level regardless of the frozen global grid spacing; the measured spacing is still reported.

non-negative smooth recession over the interface ROI with a wall-thickness guard; the depth field is frozen in the basis and pinned to zero on the ROI rim, so the five levels are nested and the untouched surface keeps the original triangles

fixed cutter position/direction frozen in the basis; the cutter size is found by a 1-D geometric search that brackets the declared contact loss and then bisects, subject to the frozen minimum representative volume. Targets that the frozen cutter cannot reach (or that would eliminate the representative body) return TARGET_INFEASIBLE with the measured maximum instead of moving the cutter. volume_loss is for bodies without a clean interface and is not renamed contact_loss.
nested paint masks from one frozen rank field; the geometry hash must stay identical (appearance-only axis).

smooth patch coverage of one frozen field; the core variant changes appearance only (geometry hash unchanged) and dirt_geometry adds an explicit contamination body registered as its own material class (plan 12.3).
original outer-surface ROI only; hidden surfaces are never backfilled

three single-factor variants (crack width, coat area, painted-coat loss) plus one explicitly bundled stress variant; crack width, crack length and layer area are never mixed into one comparable intensity (plan 30.9).
Gaussian PSF in the plane, applied to the linear signal before the response; the depth-dependent variant blends two PSFs by depth and needs per-frame depth.
single-exposure directional kernel by default; the exposure_integration variant integrates a frozen number of sub-exposures along the same trajectory.

linear sensor noise y = Poisson(g*x)/g + N(0,sigma^2) with x = max(L*2^EV, 0); photon_scale varies the photon gain with the read noise fixed, read_sigma does the opposite, and camera_noise_profile changes both (BUNDLED). Level 0 adds nothing and does not remove the renderer's existing noise.

exposure_gain acts before the photon count; digital_gain is registered separately (it is not interchangeable). The negative sub-configuration is its own variant and the dark and bright directions are never merged into one monotone scalar.
one frozen gain-direction vector; the developed profile is frozen after calibration

scene light/BRDF re-render; the zero level is the same-source baseline scene and does not claim the physical glaze has no highlight. Changing BRDF, exposure and light angle together is labelled BUNDLED.
3-D occluder bodies are added to the scene and the views are re-rendered; a delivered-pixel patch would not be an occluder.
fixed-priority nested deletion; the baseline V0 source is returned unchanged at level 0 and every level is a subset of the previous one.
baseline long edge is kept at level 0; non-zero levels apply an anti-aliased downsample and update K through the frozen pixel transform. 1/8 is the extra stress level of the plan's candidate list.
level 0 does not re-encode at all; non-zero levels run a real JPEG encode/decode and report bytes, error RMS and blockiness.
low-frequency correlated field x distance/incidence variance x a fixed outlier probability; the deployment estimate is reported separately from the audit reference RMS.
fixed nested prefix of the frozen order with a point budget; an effective N0 source keeps its real size at level 0 (no upsampling to a nominal budget).

connected holes on the observed lattice: the seed positions are frozen in the basis and only the hole radius grows with the level, so the removed sets are nested by construction and the hole area/position are measured with scipy.ndimage. Uniformly dropping points would not produce connected holes.

per-frame SE(3) perturbation followed by a real re-fusion of the per-view depth; translation and rotation are separate single-factor variants and pose_drift_profile is the explicitly bundled stress variant. A fused-only source has no frame error to produce and is NA (never a label edit).
Open3D quadric edge collapse with a measured Hausdorff budget and an ROI retention constraint; level 0 bypasses the decimator entirely.
only the observation frame and the legal scale fields change; the truth reference hash must stay identical (plan 15.4).

focal / principal point / distortion are separate single-factor variants; the perturbation is applied before back-projection and the frames are re-fused. calibration_profile changes all three and is labelled BUNDLED.

three spurious-surface variants (support bump, warped hole lid, connecting bridge) reuse synlab.observe.spurious.apply_spurious; only the observed entity changes and spurious_mask stays an audit/supervision field. The frozen height schedule of the implementation is 0/0.4/0.8/1.4/2.2 mm (plan table nominal range 0-0.5 mm) and the planned value reported is the one actually applied.
modalities are removed from the payload (presence=false) 闂?never replaced by a zero image that claims to be valid data.

boundary px error / missing blob / false positive are separate variants; every crop or ROI change updates K and the pixel transform, and the research mask (mask_reference) is never presented as the input mask.
missing context and conflicting context are separate variants; a missing context is never constructed as a necessary conflict (plan 15.5).

only the real OBS_EST fields are perturbed (never an oracle intensity). The regression variant shifts the estimate by a frozen multiple of its own measured spread, so the bias is comparable across channels; the regression variant does not report an ECE that was never defined for regression.
baseline plus four held-out camera/light/ISP presets; this is a categorical shift, so no scalar monotonicity is claimed between levels.

contract.paired_basis: all five levels share one basis_id
contract.na: inapplicable input => NA_NOT_APPLICABLE and stays in the denominator

limits.note: the 20-mother requirement is a dataset-level requirement; this audit runs on the sources available in the store plus the labelled probe fixture
